note: Reviewed CDB90 match 11, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: Wittstock municipality explicitly equates 4 October Gregorian with 24 September Julian 1636 and identifies the combined Imperial-Saxon army versus Baner and Leslie's Swedish army. Preserve the full coalition under a local ID. Modern force estimates differ from CDB; that alone does not establish a different event scope. Identity review (attacker; original CDB90 name SW ARMY): CDB SW ARMY / BANER identifies the Swedish field army; the municipal account also names Alexander Leslie. The full source total is preserved. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name IMP & SAXON ARMY): CDB IMP & SAXON ARMY is a combined force. The city and museum account identifies both commanders and components; Q12548 alone would conceal the source coalition.
